# phosphor-networkd / config_parser_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `config_parser_fuzzer` ([source](source/config_parser_fuzzer.cpp), unmodified) over phosphor-networkd (openbmc/phosphor-networkd at 1c55a458).

Parse a systemd .network file from the input, query map values and DHCP/IPv6AcceptRA helpers, then parseBool/icaseeq/KeyCheck/SectionCheck/ValueCheck/pathForIntfConf on the raw input; all results (void)-discarded, every exception caught by catch(...).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against phosphor-networkd at commit 1c55a458.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
